description: Conan Branch Picker — worktree-backed branch selection at thread creation. Source PRD: prd-conan-branch-picker.md (READ IT FIRST every iteration — it carries the mental model 'project = repo, thread = branch', the rejected checkout-in-place alternative, and Randy's ratified decisions: worktrees live in ~/.conan/worktrees/; prune auto on thread delete ONLY IF CLEAN + git worktree prune on gateway boot; 'new branch from…' bases on the repo default branch; the worktree is created AT FIRST SEND, never at picker time — abandoned drafts leave zero residue). Read CLAUDE.md + AGENTS.md first. House rules: semantic theme tokens only (shadcn neutral, monochrome primary), shadcn primitives, h-9 shrink-0 toolbars, capability-driven (no provider branching), CORS reflector + WS Origin allowlist on every new gateway endpoint. Gateway runs with `npm start` (NO watch — restart after ANY src/ edit; a stale gateway 404s new routes). Gates: `npm run typecheck` AND `npm test` AND `cd ui && npm run build`. Browser QA on the throwaway stack (CONAN_PORT=3799 CONAN_DATA_DIR=/tmp/x npm start + CONAN_PORT=3799 CONAN_UI_PORT=5199 npm run dev + CONAN_ALLOWED_ORIGINS=http://localhost:5199) — NEVER against dev :3747/:5173.

userStories.title: Branch listing backend: GET /api/fs/branches
userStories.description: As the branch picker UI, I need the gateway to list a repo's local branches so the picker has real options to render.
acceptanceCriteria: New module src/fs/branches.ts: given a cwd, resolve the repo root and return { repo: boolean, current: string | null, defaultBranch: string | null, branches: string[] } — local branches only
Non-repo cwd returns { repo: false } (never a throw); detached HEAD returns current: null
defaultBranch resolves from origin/HEAD when set, falling back to main/master if present locally
Route GET /api/fs/branches?cwd=… registered with token auth + CORS reflector like the existing /api/fs/* routes
Unit tests cover: repo with branches, non-repo dir, detached HEAD
Tests pass
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Mirror src/fs/diff.ts structure (pure logic module + thin route handler, runGit-style spawning). The composer's existing branch display endpoint (src/gateway/index.ts:347) shows the current-branch read pattern.

userStories.title: Worktree manager backend: create-or-reuse under ~/.conan/worktrees
userStories.description: As a thread starting on a non-checked-out branch, I need the gateway to create (or reuse) a git worktree for that branch and hand back its path.
acceptanceCriteria: New module src/fs/worktrees.ts: ensureWorktree({ cwd, branch, createBranch?, base? }) → { path, created, reused } with worktrees at ~/.conan/worktrees/<repo-dirname>--<branch-sanitized>/
Branch already checked out in the project folder itself → return the project folder path, no worktree (the picker's current-branch case)
Branch already has a Conan-managed worktree → reuse it, never a duplicate
createBranch: true creates the branch from the repo's default branch (explicit base override allowed) then adds the worktree
git worktree prune runs once at gateway boot for repos that have Conan-managed worktrees
Route POST /api/agent/worktrees (token auth + CORS reflector) wrapping ensureWorktree; failures return a readable error message, never a raw 500 stack
Unit tests cover: fresh create, reuse, current-branch passthrough, new-branch-from-default, invalid branch name rejected
Tests pass
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Sanitize branch names for the directory segment (slashes → dashes). Worktree root is literally ~/.conan/worktrees (os.homedir()), NOT $CONAN_DATA_DIR — ratified. git forbids two worktrees on one branch; the reuse + passthrough rules are how that constraint surfaces.

userStories.title: Worktree lifecycle: auto-prune on thread delete
userStories.description: As a user deleting a thread, I want its worktree cleaned up automatically when nothing else uses it, so worktrees don't accumulate silently.
acceptanceCriteria: DELETE /api/agent/threads/:sessionId: when the thread's cwd is a Conan-managed worktree (under ~/.conan/worktrees/) AND no other chat_thread row shares that cwd → remove the worktree
Removal only if the worktree is CLEAN (git status --porcelain empty); dirty worktrees are kept and the delete response says so (e.g. { worktreeKept: 'dirty' })
Threads whose cwd is a plain project folder are untouched by this path
Unit tests cover: last-thread clean → removed, last-thread dirty → kept, cwd shared by another thread → kept, non-worktree cwd → no-op
Tests pass
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Detection = path prefix match on the worktree root; keep the logic in src/fs/worktrees.ts (removeWorktreeIfUnused) so the route stays thin.

userStories.title: Branch picker UI in the new-thread composer flow
userStories.description: As a user starting a new chat on a git-repo project, I want to pick the branch the thread works on — or cut a new one — before my first message.
acceptanceCriteria: Draft threads (pre-first-send) on a repo project show a branch chip in the composer context row, preselected to the repo's current branch, options from GET /api/fs/branches
Chip includes a 'New branch…' action: name input, base = the repo's default branch, inline validation feedback on an invalid or taken name
Non-repo project folders show no branch chip (unchanged behaviour); existing threads never show the picker — branch is fixed at creation

First send with a non-current branch selected: POST /api/agent/worktrees first, then the thread launches with cwd = the returned worktree path; current-branch selection launches in the project folder exactly as today
The thread's existing branch display shows the picked branch after launch
Selecting a branch on a draft then abandoning the draft creates NO worktree (creation happens at first send only)
Verify in browser using automate-browser skill (light + dark, on the throwaway stack)
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Suggested skills: automate-browser, shadcn. Follow the existing composer chip pattern (provider/model/permission/effort chips in ChatPane) — DropdownMenu primitive, locks after turn 1 like the provider chip. Draft threads are local-only (no chat_thread row until first send) — the branch selection rides that same draft state.

userStories.title: Worktree thread end-to-end: surfaces inherit + fresh-worktree hint
userStories.description: As a user working in a worktree-backed thread, I want Files/Diff/Terminal and the branch display to reflect the worktree — and an honest hint that a fresh worktree has no node_modules.
acceptanceCriteria: On a worktree-backed thread: Files surface roots at the worktree, Terminal surface shell opens in the worktree cwd (pwd verified), Diff surface diffs the worktree's tree

A one-line dismissible hint shows once for a freshly CREATED worktree whose repo has a package.json but no node_modules (e.g. 'Fresh worktree — dependencies not installed'), semantic tokens only; no auto-install in v1
Reopening a worktree-backed thread resumes with the worktree cwd intact
Verify in browser using automate-browser skill: create a worktree thread on a fixture repo, walk all three surfaces + the hint, light + dark, throwaway stack
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Suggested skills: automate-browser. Surfaces already key off thread cwd — expect mostly verification + the hint component. The 'worktree deleted externally' reopen case is an OPEN QUESTION in the PRD — out of scope, do not build it.
